abstract: A 19-year old man was hospitalized suspected of a mediastinal tumor with superior vena caval syndrome. As the chest X-ray film and thoracic CT scan on admission revealed a huge anterior mediastinal tumor, and the value of serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) was high, we made a diagnosis of malignant mediastinal tumor from the germ cell. Radiation therapy was not effective, but a combination chemotherapy consisted of cis-platinum, adriamycin, and vincristine was clearly effective, decreasing the size of the tumor and normalizing the value of serum AFP. As the tumor acquired tolerance to the anticancer drugs before long, the chemotherapy became ineffective and the patient died 9 months after the initiation of the treatment. This tumor had endodermal sinus structure, Schiller-Duval body, and eosinophilic hyaline globulus which were histological characteristics of yolk sac tumor, and was confirmed to be originated from anterior mediastinum.
abstract_ja: 19歳の男性が、上大静脈症候群を伴う縦隔腫瘍の疑いで入院した。入院時の胸部X線およびCT検査で前縦隔に巨大な腫瘍が認められ、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が高値であったことから、胚細胞由来の悪性縦隔腫瘍と診断した。放射線療法は効果がなかったが、シスプラチン、アドリアマイシン、ビンクリスチンによる併用化学療法は明らかに有効であり、腫瘍は縮小し血清AFP値は正常化した。しかし、まもなく腫瘍が抗がん剤に対する耐性を獲得したため化学療法は無効となり、患者は治療開始から9か月後に死亡した。組織学的に、本腫瘍は卵黄嚢腫瘍に特徴的な内胚葉洞構造、Schiller-Duval体、好酸性硝子様小体を示し、前縦隔由来と確認された。
